land.label: Tvorcovia slideshow · Sophia
land.lead: Ako **tvorca slideshow** zverejňuješ 2 slideshow denne na TikTok účte pre **Sophiu**, zo svojho telefónu. Všetko je pre teba pripravené: slidy, popis aj hudba. Ty ich poskladáš a zverejníš.
pay.label: Tvoja odmena
pay.title: Pevná suma každý týždeň
pay.lead: Výplata je každý pondelok cez Ruul. Tvoja pevná týždenná suma závisí od krajiny: žiadne ciele sledovateľov ani zhliadnutí.
pay.resultNote: Vypláca sa každý pondelok cez Ruul za príspevky z predchádzajúceho týždňa.
pay.unavailable: Pre túto krajinu zatiaľ nie je sadzba.
do.label: Práca
do.title: Čo budeš robiť
do.1.title: Tvoj TikTok účet
do.1: Dáme ti TikTok identitu (meno, fotku, bio). Účet si založíš na telefóne a pár dní ho „zahrievaš“, presne podľa našich pokynov. Účet patrí Sophii; ty ho spravuješ.
do.2.title: 2 slideshow denne
do.2: Každý deň na teba v prehľade čakajú 2 slideshow. Zverejníš ich na TikToku a vložíš odkazy. To je všetko: ==menej ako 10 minút denne==.
do.3.title: Nič nevymýšľaš
do.3: Dáme ti fotky, text aj hudbu: len skopíruješ, vložíš a zverejníš. Jednoduchý spôsob, ako si privyrobiť za pár minút denne.
do.4.title: Pomoc, keď ju potrebuješ
do.4: Otázky? Náš tím odpovedá na Slacku a v tvojom prehľade.
who.label: Koho hľadáme
who.title: Jednoducho, pravidelne, z telefónu
who.lead: Ľudí, ktorí chcú jednoduchú a pravidelnú prácu z telefónu a dodržiavajú pokyny do písmena. **Nevystupuješ pred kamerou a nepotrebuješ skúsenosti.**
who.criteria: Prosím, neprihlasuj sa, ak nespĺňaš tieto kritériá:
crit.2: Máš smartfón a spoľahlivé pripojenie na internet
crit.3: Máš druhý telefón, ktorý môžeš používať len na túto prácu
crit.4: Môžeš zverejňovať 2 slideshow denne, 7 dní v týždni
crit.6: Súhlasíš, že pred začiatkom podpíšeš krátku zmluvu
why.label: Prečo Sophia
why.title: Prečo pracovať s nami?
why.1.title: Pevná suma každý týždeň
why.1: ==Žiadne ciele sledovateľov ani zhliadnutí==: vieš, koľko zarobíš.
why.2.title: Všetko je pripravené
why.2: Nikdy nemusíš hľadať nápady: slidy, popis aj hudba sú hotové.
why.3.title: Kedy sa ti to hodí
why.3: Pracuješ odkiaľkoľvek, v čase, ktorý ti počas dňa vyhovuje.
about.text: Sophia je aplikácia, s ktorou sa každý deň naučíš niečo nové: históriu, mytológiu, umenie, literatúru, vedu aj dnešný svet. Vydáva ju Vik Studios SAS, francúzska spoločnosť.
cta.title: Pripravený? Trvá to minútu.
form.label: Prihláška
form.title: Prihlás sa ako tvorca slideshow
form.lead: Jedna minúta, bez videa. Práca zaberie asi 10 minút denne.
form.whatsappOptin: Súhlasím so zasielaním správ cez WhatsApp o začiatku spolupráce a príspevkoch.
form.underage: Na prihlášku musíš mať aspoň 18 rokov.
form.twoPhones: Máš druhý telefón, ktorý môžeš používať len na túto prácu?
form.twoPhonesHelp: Jeden telefón slúži len pre TikTok účet, ktorý ti dáme.
form.heard: Ako si sa o nás dozvedel/a?
form.payFirst: Vyber hore svoju krajinu a uvidíš týždennú odmenu.
form.payWarning: Ak ťa to nezaujíma alebo nechceš skladať slideshow za túto sadzbu, neprihlasuj sa, prosím.
form.closedNote: V tvojej krajine zatiaľ nemáme miesta. Aj tak sa môžeš prihlásiť: keď sa tvoja krajina otvorí, napíšeme ti e-mailom.
form.commit: Budem zverejňovať 2 slideshow denne, 7 dní v týždni.
form.commitWarning: Neodosielaj, ak sa práci nebudeš venovať.
form.consent: Súhlasím, aby Vik Studios uchovávalo túto prihlášku a kontaktovalo ma ohľadom nej e-mailom a cez WhatsApp.
form.rate: Nedávno sme od teba už prihlášku dostali. Ozveme sa.
form.closed: Miesta otvárame krajinu po krajine, týždeň po týždni. Keď sa tvoja krajina otvorí, napíšeme ti e-mailom.

codes.tooMany: Príliš veľa pokusov. Požiadaj o nový kód.

ctr.label: Krok 3 z 3
ctr.title: Tvoja zmluva tvorcu
ctr.englishOnly: Zmluva je v angličtine. Podpisuješ práve túto verziu.
ctr.a2: Tvoj prístup: prehľad sa otvorí hneď po podpise. Prihlásiť sa môžeš kedykoľvek svojím e-mailom.
ctr.a3: Práca: všetko je pre teba pripravené. Stiahneš obrázky, na TikToku pridáš text a zverejníš. Asi 5 minút na jedno slideshow.
ctr.a4: Tvoja odmena: každý pondelok za predchádzajúci týždeň, cez Ruul. Založíš si bezplatný účet Ruul, overíš totožnosť a peniaze ti prídu na bankový účet.
ctr.a5: Otázky alebo koniec: opýtaj sa na čokoľvek vo svojom prehľade. Ak budeš niekedy chcieť skončiť, jednoducho nám daj vedieť, bez problému.
ctr.ruulHelp: E-mail pre tvoj účet Ruul, kam ti chodí výplata.
ctr.legalNameHelp: Meno a priezvisko presne ako v doklade totožnosti. Jeho napísanie je tvoj podpis.
ctr.note: Kliknutím na „Podpisujem“ podpisuješ túto zmluvu elektronicky. Ako dôkaz uchovávame tvoje meno, dátum, IP adresu a zariadenie.
dash.title: Tvoj štart
dash.auto: Pozvánky do Slacku a Ruulu ti prídu e-mailom. Postupuj podľa krokov nižšie svojím tempom.
dash.slip: Dokonči zahrievanie do nedele 23:59, inak sa prvý príspevok posunie o týždeň.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data Vik Studios collects when you apply on this site and, if you join, while you work with us; why; for how long; and who helps us process it.
privacy.controller.title: 1. Who is responsible for your data
privacy.controller.1: The data controller is Vik Studios SAS, 30 boulevard de Sébastopol, 75004 Paris, France (SIREN 103 372 421), represented by its President, Maximilien Kender.
privacy.controller.2: For any question about your data, write to support@vikstudios.com.
privacy.data.title: 2. The data we collect
privacy.data.1: When you apply: your first and last name, email address, WhatsApp number, country, your answers to the form (that you are 18 or older, whether you have a second phone, how you heard about us and, if you were referred, the name of the person who referred you), your consents and their date, and whether you confirmed your email and WhatsApp number with the codes we sent.
privacy.data.2: Technical data when you apply: the link you came from (referral code, campaign tags), your language, and a one-way encrypted (hashed) version of your IP address, used only to limit abuse.
privacy.data.3: If you join as a creator: the legal name you sign the contract with and the proof of signature (date, time, IP address and device); the email of your Ruul account; the emails and usernames of your work accounts (your dashboard and the TikTok account you run for us); the links and statistics of your posts (such as views, likes and shares); and your messages with our support team.
privacy.data.4: We never collect your ID document or your bank details. Ruul, the payment platform, collects them directly on its own platform, under its own privacy policy.
privacy.purposes.title: 3. Why we use it, and on what legal basis
privacy.purposes.1: To process your application and contact you about it: steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.purposes.2: To manage our collaboration and pay you: performance of the contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.purposes.3: To keep our accounting records, meet our tax and other legal obligations, and keep proof of the signed contract: legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR).
privacy.purposes.4: To send you WhatsApp messages: your consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw it at any time by replying STOP. This does not affect your application: we keep writing to you by email.
privacy.purposes.5: To keep the site secure and prevent abuse (hashed IP address, technical logs): our legitimate interest in protecting the service (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.purposes.6: We never sell your data and we do not use it for advertising.
privacy.retention.title: 4. How long we keep it
privacy.retention.1: Applications that are not selected: 12 months after the application.
privacy.retention.2: Creators: for the duration of the collaboration, then 5 years for contract and payment data (to meet our legal obligations and prove the contract). Other data is deleted when the collaboration ends.
privacy.processors.title: 5. Who processes your data for us
privacy.processors.intro: We use the following service providers. Each one only receives the data it needs for its role:
privacy.processors.supabase: Supabase: database and back end of this site and of our creator dashboard. Data is hosted in the European Union (AWS eu-west-1, Ireland).
privacy.processors.ruul: Ruul: payments. Ruul collects your ID and bank details directly on its platform, never through us. We only share with Ruul what it needs to pay you (your name, your Ruul email and the amounts).
privacy.processors.slack: Slack: communication with our team and the other creators.
privacy.processors.whatsapp: Meta (WhatsApp): sending WhatsApp messages, only if you agreed to them.
privacy.processors.google: Google: translation service, to translate messages between you and our team.
privacy.transfers.title: 6. Transfers outside the European Union
privacy.transfers.1: Some of these providers, or their own subcontractors, are based outside the European Union, mainly in the United States. These transfers are protected by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses and, where the provider is certified, by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
privacy.cookies.title: 7. Cookies and storage in your browser
privacy.cookies.1: This site uses no advertising or analytics cookies. It only keeps in your browser your language, your login session and, for 30 days, the link you came from (referral code, campaign tags). We count visits in our own database, without identifying you. The site's fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives your IP address when the page loads.
privacy.rights.title: 8. Your rights
privacy.rights.1: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, to restrict or object to its use, and to receive a copy in a portable format. You can withdraw your consent at any time. Write to support@vikstudios.com: we answer within one month.
privacy.rights.2: If you think your rights are not respected, you can file a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (www.cnil.fr), or with the data protection authority of your country.
privacy.contact.title: 9. Contact
privacy.contact.1: Vik Studios SAS, 30 boulevard de Sébastopol, 75004 Paris, France · support@vikstudios.com

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions before you apply
faq.1.q: Is this site official? Who is behind it?
faq.1.a: Yes. This site is run by Vik Studios SAS, a French company (SIREN 103 372 421, 30 boulevard de Sébastopol, 75004 Paris) that publishes the Sophia app. join.vikstudios.com is our official application site; vik-studios-creators.com is our previous application site. If you have any doubt about a message, write to support@vikstudios.com.
faq.2.q: Which personal data do you collect, and why?
faq.2.a: To process your application: your name, email, WhatsApp number, country and your answers. If you join: the legal name you sign with, your Ruul email, your work account emails, the links and statistics of your posts, and your messages with support. Everything is explained in our privacy policy: purposes, legal bases, retention periods, providers and your rights.
faq.3.q: Can I read the contract before I apply?
faq.3.a: Yes. The full contract is public, with the weekly rate of your country. It is exactly the text you sign if you are accepted.
faq.4.q: How and when am I paid?
faq.4.a: Every Monday, through Ruul, for the posts of the week before (Monday to Sunday). The amount is fixed per week and depends on your country: you see it before you apply. There is no follower or view target.
faq.5.q: Do you ask for my ID or my bank details?
faq.5.a: No. You enter your ID and bank details directly on Ruul, the payment platform, never on our site. We never see your ID document or your bank details.
faq.6.q: Can I stop whenever I want?
faq.6.a: Yes. Either side can end the collaboration at any time, without notice. The posts already published following the instructions are paid.
